parameters.name: CredentialType
parameters.description:
The type of logon credential to clear. Valid values:

- **Password**: The password.

- **PrivateKey**: The SSH private key.

parameters.name: HostAccountId
parameters.description:
The ID of the host account. The logon credential of this account will be cleared.

> Call the [ListHostAccounts](~~204372~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance. The instance contains the host account.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For information about region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
